name: grok-discord
description: Connect any Grok Bot or Cursor agent to Discord. A long-running gateway receives messages; MCP tools send replies over REST.

DISCORD_TOKEN.title: Discord bot token
DISCORD_TOKEN.description: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal. Never commit this value.

DISCORD_GUILD_ID.title: Discord server ID
DISCORD_GUILD_ID.description: Snowflake ID of the one guild this bot may speak in.

DISCORD_CHANNEL_IDS.title: Allowlisted channel IDs
DISCORD_CHANNEL_IDS.description: Comma-separated parent channel snowflakes. DMs and other channels are ignored.

DISCORD_ALLOWED_USER_IDS.title: Allowed user IDs
DISCORD_ALLOWED_USER_IDS.description: Comma-separated Discord user snowflakes. Only these users are handled. Required in intake mode (the default); the bridge refuses to start without it.

DISCORD_INTAKE_MODE.title: Intake mode
DISCORD_INTAKE_MODE.description: Optional, default true. Every message from an allowed user in an allowlisted channel is forwarded; no @mention or bot name needed. Set false for mention-driven chat.

DISCORD_ALLOWED_ROLE_IDS.title: Allowed role IDs
DISCORD_ALLOWED_ROLE_IDS.description: Optional comma-separated role snowflakes, checked in addition to DISCORD_ALLOWED_USER_IDS. Empty means no extra role check.

GROK_WEBHOOK_URL.title: Grok Bot webhook URL
GROK_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Optional. HTTPS URL the gateway POSTs inbound Discord events to. Required together with GROK_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Loopback HTTP is allowed only for local development.

GROK_WEBHOOK_SECRET.title: Webhook secret
GROK_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Required when GROK_WEBHOOK_URL is set. HMAC-SHA256 of the JSON body and Authorization: Bearer. Never commit this value.

BOT_NAME_PREFIX.title: Bot name prefix
BOT_NAME_PREFIX.description: Optional spoken name. Matched as a whole word anywhere in the message after mentions are stripped. Defaults to the Discord username.
